title: Without Customers View, A/R Summary names are not links
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user whose role has Reports page access but no Customers View.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Point at a customer name.
  4. Click the customer name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • the name is plain text (not blue).

Step 4:

  • nothing opens; you stay on A/R Aging Summary.

Why this matters: A user who cannot see customers must not be sent to customer detail.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:159; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:330-337. V1 code, quoted: `const canViewCustomers = permissionService.canView('customers'); ... if (canViewCustomers && row.customerId !== null)`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-058) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-d07623f (staging) on 11/12/2026.
